displayName: OCI-MITRE-ATTACK-026: MITRE T1047: Windows Management Instrumentation
description:
Detects ATT&CK technique T1047 (Windows Management Instrumentation). Adversaries may abuse Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) to execute malicious commands and payloads. WMI is designed for programmers and is the infrastructure for management data and operations 

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_mitre_attack_mitre_attack_026", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%mitre%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%t1047%') AND "value" > 0
